question.text: A change in control of the AIF requires:

answer.text: Only notification to SEBI after the change

explanation.text: The Logic: A change in control of the Category I/II AIF, Sponsor, or Investment Manager requires prior approval from SEBI; mere changes of Sponsor or Manager (without a change in control) need to be informed to SEBI. The Trap: Investor-vote-based approval, post-facto notification, or no approval at all all fall short of the prior-SEBI-approval bar that applies specifically to control changes. Note: Source pages 45 and 84 of Series XIX-A AIF (Category I and II) Distributors workbook.
